page_shape.no_form_element: controls are not wrapped in a <form>; form_index is null for every control. Group by the page, not by form.
page_shape.route: job page at /<org>/<uuid>; blank form at /<org>/<uuid>/application. Job page has one 'Apply for this Job' button; both routes share document.title '<title> @ <company>'.
page_shape.autofill_block: An 'Autofill from resume' file input (accept pdf/doc/docx/odt/rtf/txt/md) with 'Upload file' button precedes the form on all 3 samples. It parses a resume to prefill fields; it is NOT the resume field.

control_families.text: input[type=text|email|tel|url] with placeholder 'Type here...' / 'hello@example.com...' / '1-415-555-1234...' / 'https://example.com...'; label via <label for>. System fields have ids _systemfield_name, _systemfield_email; custom fields have UUID ids/names.
control_families.location_typeahead: input[role=combobox] placeholder 'Start typing...' labelled 'Location'; no static options; requires typing to populate (not exercised).
control_families.file: input[type=file]#_systemfield_resume labelled 'Resume' with 'Upload File' button; accept includes pdf, doc, docx, odt, rtf, txt, md AND image/*, video/*, audio/*; multiple=false.
control_families.textarea: textarea with UUID id for long-form custom questions (ab-01).
control_families.radio_group: native input[type=radio] sharing a UUID name per question; each option has its own <label for>; the question text is a sibling label/element ABOVE the group, not a fieldset legend.
control_families.checkbox_group: native input[type=checkbox] where input.name equals the OPTION LABEL (e.g. name='Yes', name='White'); question text is a sibling element above the group. Yes/No questions may be rendered as a checkbox pair (ab-03 sponsorship), not radios.
control_families.submit: button[type=submit] text 'Submit Application' at the bottom.

runtime_observations: Custom field ids/names are UUIDs and CHANGED between two loads of the same Tempo form (survey group prefix d9fe43ea… then d93b485c…). Never persist Ashby ids; bind by label text each observation.
A 'Loading...' progress cue is present in the DOM even after render; do not use it as a readiness signal.
required is expressed via the required attribute on the input (aria-required not used); labels carry no '*'.
Checkbox option inputs use name=<option label>, so name is NOT a group key; group by the nearest question text above the options.
Yes/No screening may be a checkbox pair, which allows both or neither to be checked; runtime must enforce exactly-one for such questions.

inferred.location_typeahead_inference: Typing likely triggers a place-autocomplete list; selecting an option probably required for the value to commit.
inferred.resume_required_inference: When Resume is required and Autofill is used, the autofill file may also populate the resume field (unverified).

provider_hint.for_jev: Ashby single-page form, no <form> element. Bind by visible label text; ids are unstable UUIDs. Name is one full-name field. Yes/No screening may be checkbox pairs. Free-text inputs are used even for yes/no-style questions (work authorization, sponsorship) on some employers, so classify by label semantics not control type. Stop at 'Submit Application'.

edge_cases: Cover letter may be requested as a URL field ('Portfolio/Cover Letter/Supporting Documents') rather than an upload.
Resume accept list includes image/video/audio types; do not treat 'accept' as a strict document filter.
Same employer may mark phone/LinkedIn required on one posting and optional on another.
